name: fresh_dev_v1
describes: A brand-new dev character: no gear in any slot, all 12 skills at level 1 with 0 XP, no quests beyond the automatic tutorial start, no lodestones built (only the inactive Temple lodestone), spawn at the church start area.
open_questions: Lodestone state and quest state must be read by the probe (quests: v2 reads QuestProgressComponent; lodestones: not yet).
Scene spawns (creatures 40 m off) are not grants; confirm on dev they do not aggro before he engages.
The game's character-name rule is not in the reflection dump: names are kept to 16 alnum/_ characters; a rejected name is a fixture gap.
Created characters accumulate in SaveCharacters and Steam Cloud (logs/bench/dev_characters.jsonl lists them for clean-up).
grant_policy: Luis 2026-10-26: main variants grant NO items; he obtains every prerequisite himself (his Director plans them). Grant-using setups belong only to *_quick cases (variant quick, never counted for GOAL).

character_policy.fresh: cases with fixtures.character = 'fresh' (M3 asked/initiative/plus5, capstone stage 1) get a NEW character per case, CD_<case tag>_<run tag>, made by evals/bench/devchar.py (create_char -> pick_char -> join dev; every switch relaunches the client, BUGS L24); the name is recorded in the case result
character_policy.main: every other case runs on ClaudeDev, the long-lived main dev character (M4-M6 progression): it is NOT fresh
character_policy.chain:<case>: continue the character that verified <case> (route B snapshot/restore, not built: a fixture gap until then)
